parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hi, I'm really interested in exploring the famous Southwest Cycle Path. Any suggestions?

Definitely. The Southwest Cycle Path is not just for cycling, it can also be used for walking. It's a scenic route that spans 50 kilometres.

That sounds amazing. Is there any information available to help me plan my trip?

Absolutely. I recommend checking out the website greenride.org.uk. As its name suggests, it's dedicated to promoting riding a bike as a green mode of transport.

What information does it offer?

They provide detailed information about the path, including the distance, preparations you can make and most importantly, a good map to help you navigate. It's a great resource to ensure you don't miss any major attractions or get lost.

That's great. Do they offer guided tours for group travel? Some of my friends want to join me as well.

Yes, if you prefer traveling in groups, they provide a guide for each group consisting of five to fifteen people. This ensures a personalized experience for everyone.

Wow, that sounds like a fun way to explore. Are there any specific routes that are popular among cyclists?

Definitely. The Valley Trail is the most popular route. It not only offers stunning scenic views, but also has three huts for bird-watching enthusiasts. Just remember, while you can take photos, we don't recommend feeding wildlife.

That's fantastic.

Do I need to bring my own bike? Or can I rent one?

You can rent a bike from Cycle Fast. They have rental options starting from nine pounds for a minimum of five hours. Even if you finish the whole trip within four hours, you still need to pay this amount.

That's reasonable. It's a long and demanding trip after all. They also offer other cycling equipment like helmets, which are provided for free. Plus, those traveling with children can also rent a child seat at four pounds.

That's convenient. Should I make a booking in advance?

Yes, it's advisable to make an early booking, especially during the holiday. Cycle Fast might have limited availability if you wait until the last minute.

Great. How can I contact Cycle Fast to make bike reservations?

You can reach out to Cycle Fast to make your booking and inquire about their services. Their hotline is 01743 228906.

Thank you for the information. Is there anything else I should keep in mind before starting my cycling adventure?

Yes, make sure to check the weather conditions before you begin. Sometimes thunderstorms, hurricanes or hail can lead to the temporary closure of the cycling path for safety reasons.

That's a good reminder. Lastly, what about parking options near the cycling path?

When driving to the cycling path, you can find parking available behind the post office, which should be convenient for you.

Thank you so much for all the information. I can't wait to start cycling and explore the Southwest Cycle Path.

analyses.content: 工作人员建议查看专门推广绿色出行的网站 greenride.org.uk 来获取路线信息。
Absolutely. I recommend checking out the website greenride.org.uk. As its name suggests, it's dedicated to promoting riding a bike as a green mode of transport。
网址听写题。卷面已印有 .org.uk，只需填写主体部分。注意单词是由 green 和 ride 组成的复合词。
They provide detailed information about the path, including the distance, preparations you can make and most importantly, a good map to help you navigate。
听到 including 引导的一连串名词（distance, preparations）时定位，最后一个提到的核心实物即为答案。
该网站提供详细的路线准备建议，以及一份非常重要的 good map（地图）来防止游客迷路。
Yes, if you prefer traveling in groups, they provide a guide for each group consisting of five to fifteen people。
听到数字 five to fifteen 定位。卷面 accompanied by 对应原文中的 provide a... for each group。
对于 5 到 15 人的团体游客，网站会为每个小组配备一名 guide（导游）提供个性化服务。
The Valley Trail is the most popular route. It not only offers stunning scenic views, but also has three huts for bird-watching enthusiasts。
听到数字 three 之后的名词。注意复合词的拼写，卷面 spots 对应原文的 huts。
在最受欢迎的 Valley Trail 路线中，设有三个专门供 birdwatching（观鸟）爱好者使用的木屋。

You can rent a bike from Cycle Fast. They have rental options starting from nine pounds for a minimum of five hours. Even if you finish the whole trip within four hours, you still need to pay this amount。
高能时间干扰！ 录音中提到了 four hours（四小时），但那是假设你提前骑完的情况，实际收费的起步时长（minimum）是 five hours。
租车费用为 9 英镑，这涵盖了至少 5 hours（5小时）的使用时长，即使提前还车也按此计费。
带小孩出行的游客可以额外支付 4 英镑租赁一个 child seat（儿童座椅）。
Plus, those traveling with children can also rent a child seat at four pounds。
听到金额 four pounds 定位。前文提到了 helmets（头盔），但那是 free（免费）的，只有 child seat 需要付费租赁。
Yes, it's advisable to make an early booking, especially during the holiday. Cycle Fast might have limited availability if you wait until the last minute。
听到 booking 和 early 之后定位。卷面中的 season 在原文中被 especially during 引导出的时间名词所修饰。
工作人员建议在 holiday（假期）季节提前预约，以免最后时刻无车可租。
You can reach out to Cycle Fast to make your booking and inquire about their services. Their hotline is 01743 228906。
长数字听写需保持专注，注意 0 的读法（zero 或 oh），确保每一位数字都准确记录。
预订自行车的客服热线电话号码是 01743228906。
Yes, make sure to check the weather conditions before you begin. Sometimes thunderstorms, hurricanes or hail can lead to the temporary closure of the cycling path for safety reasons。
听到 before starting/begin 后定位。后面提到的 thunderstorms 等具体天气是用来解释为什么要检查“天气状况”的干扰/补充信息。
出发前必须检查 weather conditions（天气状况），因为极端天气可能导致路径关闭。
Yes, make sure to check the weather conditions before you begin. Sometimes thunderstorms, hurricanes or hail can lead to the temporary closure of the cycling path for safety reasons。
When driving to the cycling path, you can find parking available behind the post office, which should be convenient for you。
听到 parking 和 behind 之后，紧跟的建筑名词即为答案。注意首字母大写以示规范（虽然雅思通常不强制要求大小写）。
对于开车来的游客，车可以停在 post office（邮局）后方的停车场。
